reasons.claim: Notified 3.88 ha regeneration felling in Flen, status notified. Completed felling overlaps only 0.065 ha (1.7%, a 2008 felling), so the site is not already felled.

One eligible species within 250 m: Goodyera repens (VU, vascular plant, forest-associated, site-bound). Its listed threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness of tree-covered land. The record is 145 m from the polygon edge (uncertainty 25 m, 2021).

Supporting context: NT lichen Carbonicola anthracophila at 90 m (2019, uncertainty 10 m), forest-associated and site-bound with several felling-relevant threats. It is the only site-bound forest NT species within 250 m, so the 3-species NT trigger is not met.

Effort within 1000 m is 705 records, just below the county median of 724 (42nd percentile). Near-site there are 10 records of 10 species on 3 days within 250 m, against a county median of 12, and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The Goodyera repens record is 145 m outside the polygon; it does not show the species occupies the felling area.
The records are from 2019 and 2021; the present state of the habitat is unknown.
Effort is slightly below the county median, and near-site recording is sparse (no records inside the polygon).
not_established: That Goodyera repens or the lichen grows on the notified stand.
Presence or absence of other red-listed species inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell, or any legal status of the species.
next_action: Ask a reviewer to place the Goodyera repens record (GBIF 3430105173) and the lichen record (GBIF 2271877462) against the polygon boundary, and consider a field check of the stand for these species and for dead wood before felling begins.
